package.name: 扩展示例 · 文本统计与邻里来信
package.description: 可独立选装的通用文本统计工具与微信式 AI 对话游戏。游戏包含三个原创联系人、自由聊天、朋友圈、点赞评论与进度恢复。
package.author: alfredxw
package.usage: 按需选装文本统计插件与邻里来信游戏。在扩展中启用统计工具集；在游戏中创建邻里来信故事，配置文本模型并授权所需权限后开始游玩。
package.compatibility: 需要 Denova 扩展 API v1。统计工具需要 Node.js；游戏需要配置文本模型并授权角色会话与实例存档。界面为虚构社交游戏。

en-US.name: Extension examples · statistics & Small Circle
en-US.description: Independently selectable text statistics and a messaging-style AI social game with three original contacts, free-form chat, moments, likes, comments and saved progress.
en-US.usage: Select the statistics plugin and Small Circle game independently. Enable the statistics toolset in Extensions; create a Small Circle story in Games, configure its text model and grant the required permissions to play.
en-US.compatibility: Requires Denova extension API v1. Statistics needs Node.js; the fictional social game needs a text model, Agent sessions and instance storage permissions.
